credit_factors.label: Repayment history
credit_factors.what: Pay credit cards, loans and BNPL on time. This is the single biggest factor.

credit_factors.label: Credit enquiries
credit_factors.what: Every application sits on your file for 12 months. Fewer is better.

credit_factors.label: Limits & debt
credit_factors.what: High limits and balances read as risk to a lender.

credit_factors.label: Defaults
credit_factors.what: Unpaid debts sent to collection stay on file for years.

actions.label: Answered a question
actions.why_rewards_you: Engaging with your plan helps the AI personalise it. Kept low value so it can't be farmed by tapping randomly.

actions.label: Completed a plan goal
actions.why_rewards_you: Completing a goal is a real, verifiable step toward better credit health.

actions.label: On-time repayment
actions.why_rewards_you: Repayment history is the single biggest factor in your Australian credit score.

actions.label: No new BNPL this month
actions.why_rewards_you: Fewer credit enquiries and debts protects your credit profile.

actions.label: Switched a bill
actions.why_rewards_you: Frees up cash so you can make every repayment on time.

actions.label: Cancelled a subscription
actions.why_rewards_you: Cuts recurring spending so you can pay down debt faster.

actions.label: Rescheduled a payment
actions.why_rewards_you: Avoiding a dishonour fee keeps your account in good standing.

actions.label: Verified a saving
actions.why_rewards_you: Awarded only once the old debit stops appearing in your transactions — a saving we can prove, not just promise.

actions.label: 4-week savings streak
actions.why_rewards_you: Consistency is what actually moves a credit score.

actions.label: Shop purchase
actions.why_rewards_you: Spending coins on your dragon never earns XP — rewards only ever come from good money habits.

goals.title: Pay your credit card on time
goals.description: Set up autopay or a reminder so the due date never slips.

goals.title: No new Buy-Now-Pay-Later this month
goals.description: Pause Afterpay and Zip for 30 days to protect your credit profile.

goals.title: Cut $90+ a month from your bills
goals.description: Approve cheaper plans in the Bill Negotiator to free up cash.
